en: Black‑and‑white image of a large rectangular manor or small palace with a steep tiled roof and central baroque gable, seen from a garden lawn with trees and a curved path in the foreground. The façade has three stories of regularly spaced windows with decorative window heads and a balustraded terrace at the center. In the lower right corner, small printed text credits the photographers or publishers.
